answers.a1: The speaker emphasizes that AI automation removes repetitive manual workflows, enabling teams to scale video localization 10x faster while maintaining human-in-the-loop oversight.
answers.a2: Pricing is structured around storage tiers and monthly consumable AI minutes, offering transparent scalable plans with optional standalone storage expansion add-ons.
answers.a3: The recommended architecture utilizes an asynchronous pipeline queue with decoupled transcription, neural translation, and multi-speaker voice synthesis engines.

ragFlow.title: How RAG Turns Video into Grounded Truth
ragFlow.subtitle: Unlike generic LLMs that hallucinate, VidNova anchors every answer strictly within your transcribed video context.
ragFlow.step1Desc: Speech is converted to timestamped text segments and speaker blocks.
ragFlow.step2Desc: Semantic vectors are generated and indexed in high-dimensional space.
ragFlow.step3Desc: Your query retrieves the most semantically relevant video timestamps.
ragFlow.step4Desc: LLM formulates precise answers strictly citing the source timestamps.
